newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia wholesale gas prices seen cut 30 pct-agency.
newsitem.headline: Russia wholesale gas prices seen cut 30 pct-agency.

text.p: Russia will soon cut the wholesale price of high-pressure natural gas by 30 percent, Interfax news agency quoted First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov as saying on Thursday.
Nemtsov said Rem Vyakhirev, chairman of Russian gas monopoly Gazprom GAZP.RTS, had agreed to the change, it quoted him as saying.
There was no indication if the cut would include exports but Russian officials have generally spoken about decreasing energy prices for domestic industry.
Gazprom officials were unaware of the agreement and could not comment on the 30 percent cut.
But board member Alexander Semenyaka said Gazprom sold all its gas to middlemen in high-pressure form. He noted that there was a big difference between the price before tax and after tax.
